jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Husqvarna Group, we develop innovative solutions that shape the future of sustainable productivity. As part of our automation and product development environment in Huskvarna, you will join a team working closely with advanced test systems, industrial automation, and product verification. Our engineers collaborate across multiple product groups and projects, contributing to the development, commissioning, and continuous improvement of automated systems that support world-class products and technologies. This is an opportunity to work in a technically advanced environment where innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning are central to our success.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to strengthen our team in Huskvarna. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing automation solutions and test systems used within our engineering and product development environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Programming and developing PLC-based automation solutions, primarily in Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
    Commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimizing automated equipment and test systems
    Supporting machine safety implementation and ensuring compliance with relevant standards
    Working with system integration and communication between automation systems and connected equipment
    Collaborating with internal stakeholders across product groups, projects, and improvement initiatives
    Participating in the development of new test solutions as well as the continuous improvement of existing systems
    Providing technical expertise and contributing to long-term automation strategies

This is a hands-on role where you will drive automation initiatives independently while working closely with engineers, developers, and internal customers.

About you

Desired skills, qualifications, and experience

    Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field
    Several years of experience working with industrial automation systems
    Extensive experience programming PLC systems in Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
    Experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of automated systems
    Knowledge of machine safety standards and implementation
    Understanding of industrial communication protocols and system integration
    Experience working with test systems or automated production equipment is highly beneficial
    Fluent in English, both written and spoken
    Swedish language skills are strongly meritorious

Personal attributes

To succeed in this role, you are:

    Self-driven and comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions
    Analytical and structured in your approach to problem-solving
    Collaborative and able to build strong relationships across teams
    Curious and motivated by learning new technologies and concepts
    Quality-focused with a continuous improvement mindset
    Comfortable balancing independent work with teamwork in a dynamic environment

What we offer

At Husqvarna Group, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced technology in a global organization that values innovation, collaboration, and professional growth.

We offer:

    A technically challenging role with significant responsibility and influence
    Opportunities to work on advanced automation and test system solutions
    A collaborative and supportive work environment
    Professional development and continuous learning opportunities
    The possibility to contribute to products and technologies used worldwide
    A culture where innovation, teamwork, and individual growth are encouraged

Location

Huskvarna, Sweden.

Your application

Can you envision yourself being a part of this? If so, send us your application! Selection is ongoing. Note: We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR compliance.

For questions regarding the process please contact

Recruiter: Jonathan Olsson jonathan.olsson@husqvarnagroup.com or

Hiring Manager: Hans Berntsson, hans.berntsson@husqvarnagroup.com

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

· Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.

· Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.

· Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.title: Ohjaaja, Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikkö
jobs.description:
Tule sellaisena kuin olet!

Etsimme mielenterveys, päihde- ja asunnottomuustyöstä kiinnostunutta lähihoitajaa vakinaiseen ohjaajan tehtävään Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikköön. Aloitus heti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Edellytämme soveltuvaa tutkintoa sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon alalta esim. lähihoitajan tutkinto (kelpoisuusehto: laki sosiaalihuollon ammatillisen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista 272/2005) sekä tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa ja tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Katsomme eduksi aikaisemman kokemusta päihde- ja mielenterveystyöstä, mutta tärkeintä on kyky kohdata asiakkaat vaihtelevissa elämäntilanteissaan ja toimia osana työyhteisöä. Olet hyvä tyyppi, joka ei kavahda vauhtia ja vaarallisia tilanteita. Sinulla on kyky sopeutua nopeastikin muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja siedät keskeneräsyyttä. Tarjoamme mahtavan työporukan lisäksi vaihtelevan ja mielenkiintoisen työn, jossa kahta samanlaista päivää ei ole. Saat työllesi kattavan perehdytyksen ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen.

Ohjaajilla on yksikössämme käytössä työvuoroautonomia, joten työvuorot on mahdollista suunnitella henkilökohtaiseen elämäntilanteeseesi sopivaksi. Työ on 3-vuorotyötä ja sisältää sekä arki- että viikonlopputyötä.

Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikkö toimii Asunto ensin-periaatteella tarjoten tuettua asumista asunnottomuutta kokeneille. Yksikössä on 89 asukaspaikkaa ja henkilökunta paikalla ympäri vuorokauden. Yksikön perustehtävänä on turvata asukkaisen asuminen omissa vuokra-asunnoissaan. Kantavana ajatuksena on tarjota asukkaille mahdollisuus ihmisarvoiseen elämään, johon olennaisena osana kuuluu asunto, osallisuuden kokemus omaan elämään, yhteisöön ja yhteiskuntaan.

Ohjaajan tehtäviin asumispalveluyksikössä kuuluvat asukkaan ohjaaminen ja tukeminen erilaisissa arjen hallintaan ja asumiseen liittyvissä asioissa. Työ sisältää asukkaiden fyysisen ja psyykkisen terveydentilan arviointia ja tarpeen mukaan ohjaamista terveydenhuollon ja sosiaalihuollon palveluiden piiriin. Ohjaajan tukena työssä ovat ohjaajien työryhmän lisäksi yksikön sairaanhoitaja, sosiaaliohjaajat, työvalmentaja, tiiminvetäjä, esihenkilö sekä yksikön johtaja.

Palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n G21 (2543,33-2871,53). Tarjoamme lisäksi työterveyshuollon ja e-passiedun.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tuetun asumisen esihenkilö Anu Ratinen puh. 045-77347362. Vapaamuotoiset hakemukset pyydetään jättämään mahdollisimman pian, paikka täytetään heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä ja haastatteluja tehdään jo hakuaikana, joten ole pian yhteydessä, jos ja kun kiinnostuksesi heräsi!

jobs.title: Vil du være min forlengede arm i en aktiv hverdag? (BPA til kvinne 47 år)
jobs.description:
Jeg er en kvinne på 47 år som lever et aktivt liv sammen med min familie og våre hunder. Nå leter jeg etter en pålitelig og fleksibel brukerstyrt personlig assistent (BPA) som kan gi meg den praktiske støtten jeg trenger for at hverdagen skal gå smidig.

I denne rollen er det du som er assistenten – din oppgave er å være mine hender og føtter, slik at jeg kan gjennomføre mine daglige gjøremål og holde på med min store lidenskap: hundetrening.

Hva innebærer jobben?

Arbeidsoppgavene varierer etter mine behov, men vil i hovedsak bestå av:

  • I hjemmet: Praktisk bistand til husarbeid, rengjøring og enkle dagligdagse oppgaver.

  • Aktivitet og tur: Bli med som ledsager på turer i skog og mark.

  • Hundetrening: Assistere med det praktiske under trening, slik at jeg kan bruke min energi på selve aktiviteten.

  • Bilkjøring: Fungere som sjåfør til avtaler, ærender og treninger.


Jeg søker deg som ønsker en fast arbeidsplan, men som også har mulighet til å stille opp fleksibelt ved sykdom eller ekstra behov.
At vi har god kjemi er det aller viktigste for meg.

Kvalifikasjoner og egenskaper:

  • Glad i dyr: Hunder er en stor del av livet mitt – du må trives godt rundt firbeinte.

  • Førerkort klasse B: Et absolutt krav, da du skal kjøre min bil.

  • Språk: Du behersker norsk muntlig og skriftlig (minimum B1-nivå).

  • Selvstendig og initiativrik: Du ser hva som må gjøres, trår til der det trengs og har god gjennomføringsevne.

  • Pålitelig og personlig egnet: Du er trygg, tålmodig og har respekt for at arbeidsplassen din er mitt private hjem.

  • Langsiktig: Du ønsker en stabil jobb og ser for deg å være en del av mitt team over tid.

Hva tilbyr jeg?

  • En variert, aktiv og meningsfull hverdag.

  • Et trivelig arbeidsmiljø med både folk og dyr.

  • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter gjeldende avtaleverk via BPA-leverandør.

Mangfold beriker arbeidsmiljøet, og jeg oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke!


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.description:
Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

Payroll specialist

At Maersk, we have a vision larger than the ocean: to be a true integrator of container logistics connecting and simplifying our customers’ supply chain. We count on our people to make it happen.

Besides focusing on creating value for our customers and the business, a key priority for us is to drive personal and professional development for our people to prepare for further career progression.

We value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job.



We Offer

Energizing and pioneering, this is an environment that keeps you motivated.

You’ll be joining a genuinely diverse and talented team that is truly passionate about providing first class HR partnership to the business. And thanks to our global scale, you’ll be well-placed to explore Maersk opportunities around the world.

The many other highlights include industry-leading talent develop initiatives and competitive benefits.

You will be joining a Fortune 500 company and will get the opportunity to challenge yourself in a truly aspiring, international, and fast-paced environment with our team in Gothenburg and all over the world. In cooperation with colleagues and vendors your role will be to ensure a flawless payroll service to Swedish and Norwegian employees. This will give you a unique opportunity to interact with colleagues, across the globe and from all business areas within the Maersk group, all while having a continuous focus on your professional and personal development too.

Key Responsibilities

The purpose of the role is to support the regional payroll organization, working with a matrixed group of stakeholders and vendors to ensure great employee experience and regulatory compliance from a payroll delivery perspective. Key responsibilities:

    Manage pre-payroll, on-cycle payroll, off-cycle payroll processes
    Extract the T&A data and provide the same to payroll provider
    Validate payroll results & provide approvals for final pay credits based on control reports
    Annual payroll reconciliation and new Payroll Year preparation
    Ensure timely Social Insurance Tax Payment and Reporting
    Manage advance payments
    Adjust basic time configuration of systems after initial implementation, as approved/required
    Track vendor deliverables on payroll SLAs vide defined payroll metrics
    Be risk aware and help identify, report, mitigate and track risks in the payroll delivery process
    Support the Payroll team lead in providing necessary data and clarifications to questions raised by audit – internal and external
    Manage the timely submission of RICC controls  
    Participate in Time and Attendance initiatives including system upgrades, communication of changes to People Partners, testing and documenting all changes for historical and record retention policies, project support as needed
    Interfaces with People Partner to support employee/ manager queries
    Identify improvement opportunities in regional processes and raises them to global process managers

Who we are looking for

You are data, systems and process savvy in the Payroll, HR, Time & Attendance domain and are excited about putting your deep expertise at work in the transition into new technology and processes at Maersk.

You want to propel your career further by gaining unique project experience in an international environment and would like to play a key role in building the future payroll delivery landscape and solutions.

As we progress with the transformation you are comfortable with your role changing shape and scope. You will be responsible for high quality delivery of Payroll Services and continuously driving improvements to ensure great employee experience process optimization and compliance.

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience in managing Payroll, Time & Attendance and HR processes, within a complex international organization

• Knowledge of compliance and legal regulations for payroll & benefits

• Broader HR Operations experience as well as exposure to an outsourced payroll model would be a benefit

• Ability to effectively engage and mobilize diverse local HR stakeholders

• A proactive, ‘let’s get it done’ attitude geared towards continuous improvement

• Flexibility and adaptability to operate in a fast-paced, developing project environment, taking ownership and setting directions with minimal guidance

• Resilience: the change process, is anything but straightforward; accepting uncertainty and bouncing back from setbacks while keeping your enthusiasm is a tall order, but we need it

• Collaborative working style, fostering cooperation and teamwork to find solutions

• Fluency in Swedish and English is essential

• If you have worked with ‘transportavtalet’, is an advantage too

• Highly analytical approach with a strong eye for detail

• Structured working style and focus on delivering results as per agreed timescales and scope

Selection is ongoing, so we look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Tilkallingsvikar søkes til nattevakt
jobs.employer: MEDVIND ASSISTANSE AS AVD TROMS OG FINNMARK
jobs.description:
Tilkalling/ ekstravakt som superassistent på natt

Er du et nattmenneske som liker å være våkne når resten av verden sover. Er du god på å være stille? Liker du varierte vakter men med noe rolige perioder? Er du god på å liste deg rundt i nattens møre?  Kanskje er akkurat du nattevakten jeg leter etter? Jeg søker noen som kan være våken når jeg sover og bidra til at kveldene og morgenen mine blir supre.

Mine assistenter sier ofte at å jobbe for meg er verdens rareste, men også fineste jobb. Jeg lever et liv fjernt fra rutiner der noen dager er like mens andre dager skjer det 1000 ting.  Mine superassistenter gjør det mulig for meg å reise, jobbe og ta en doktorgrad. Jeg er engasjert i politikk og er med i flere organisasjoner. Det som derimot ikke fungerer så bra er kroppen min, jeg har en omfattende funksjonshemming bruker rullestol og pustehjelp. Det vil si at det er endel medisinske oppgaver i hverdagen. Det kan være litt blålys stemning noen ganger. Men med god opplæring og alt det medisinske utstyret er det ingen sak. Vi tuller ofte med at vi har med oss et lite lokalsykehus på tur.

Jeg ønsker superassistenter som vil være med å gjøre livet mitt mulig, du trenger ingen erfaring da alt kan læres. Det viktigste er at du ser meg som person, vil gjøre en god innsats og tar instruksjoner. Min erfaring er at de beste assistentene er de som ikke har peiling når de begynner, men har lyst å lære. Jeg trenger selvstendige og handlekraftige assistenter som er med på mitt liv på mine vilkår.

Du må tilfredsstille følgende krav

  • parfyme- og røykfri
  • Lappen klasse B
  • Plettfri vandelsattest
  • Glad i en utfordring
  • Snakke norsk, norsk tegnspråk eller Skandinavisk

Det er nå ledige stillinger som tilkallingsvikar på natt. Hos meg er det 12 timers vakter og intensive arbeidsperioder. Turnusen er godkjent av fagforbundet, og består av 5 vakter på, 7 av, 2 på, 7 av, samt at det kan være flere vakter på reise etter særlig avtale.

Arbeidsted er enten i min bolig i Tromsø eller der jeg til enhver tid befinner meg. Du må dekke egen bolig i Tromsø, men får dekt opphold og reise om vi er andre steder.

Alle kjønn er velkommen til å søke. Menn, skeive, transpersoner og ikke-binære oppfordres til å søke.

Om du tror dette er din greie, send en søknad til Ith@medvindassistanse.no

Merk søknaden med «nattevakt»

Søknader behandles fortløpende, oppstart etter avtale


Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Wärtsilä Finland Oy, Delivery Centre Sustainable Technology Hub, is looking for an On-call Trainee for Operative Purchasing. The position is a temporary position for about 6 months (0-25 hours/week) and the location is Vaasa, Finland. The person selected for this role needs to be a full-time student studying for a degree in Finland.


Your role and responsibilities

As an On-call Trainee, you will work in an assistive role to secure on-time material availability and to optimize the inventory levels together with operative purchasers and in collaboration with several different stakeholders with diverse expertise.


Your work will focus on assisting with these responsibilities:

* Ensure the right amount of required material to be available when needed

* Manage and measure supplier quality level
* Manage document revisions for suppliers
* Maintain and develop material master data

To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Studies and interest in Engineering, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or similar

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

  • Sammensætning af det rette team til de enkelte opgaver.

  • Samarbejde med øvrige arbejdsledere for at sikre optimal koordinering på tværs af afdelinger.

  • Opfølgning på timeforbrug og materialeforbrug på ordrer.

  • Opfølgning på ekstraarbejde og sikring af overensstemmelse mellem tilbud og udførelse.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er udlært inden for elektronik (Elektronikmekaniker, elektronikfagtekniker, el-ingeniør, installatør el.lign.). Du kan også være udlært elektriker med interesse/erfaring og flair for elektronik.

  • Er pligtopfyldende, fleksibel og imødekommende.

  • En fast stilling på fuldtid.

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedssikring.

  • En anderledes og spændende arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerhed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er topprioriteter.

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af et internationalt team, hvor vi sætter kvalitet i højsædet, så skal du sende din ansøgning afsted nu. Vi behandler ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Ansøgning sendes til:          job@kselektro.dk

Tiltrædelse:                            Snarest muligt – eller efter aftale.

 

KS Elektro A/S er et ungt firma, der har stor erfaring og stærke kompetencer indenfor levering af el- og elektronik løsninger til den maritime industri. Vi beskæftiger ca. 150 medarbejdere i Skagen.

Med vores søsterselskab Karstensens Skibsværft, som er førende indenfor nybygning af pelagiske fartøjer og reparationer af forskellige skibstyper, beskæftiger vi tilsammen over 650 medarbejdere. jobs.title: Postdoctor in plant developmental biology
jobs.description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology

The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

About the position

The long-term goal of our research is to understand the signaling mechanisms regulating plant growth and development (https://www.upsc.se/researchers/6171-robert-stephanie-regulation-of-plant-cell-shape-acquisition.html). You will be part of a team that work at building a better understanding in the signaling controlling cell fate acquisition in Arabidopsis root. The candidate will aim at dissecting the role of the cuticle layer in this process. The project is based on cell biology including live confocal microscopy, molecular biology and transcriptomics.

Your profile

Applicants require a doctoral degree in molecular, cell or developmental biology, or related disciplines. Furthermore, applicants should be proficient in English and should have the ability to work independently as well as in collaboration with others. Experience in confocal microscopy, Arabidopsis, transcriptomics is of merit.

About us

UPSC belongs to two universities, the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and Umeå University. About 200 people from more than 40 different nationalities work here. We host some 30 principal investigators, and our researchers have access to state-of-the-art analytical platforms, unique tree germplasm resources and plant growth facilities. We strive for a collaborative work environment and support our scientists throughout all career stages by providing professional training opportunities and individual career mentoring.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology, SLU, Umeå.

Form of employment:

Fixed-term employment 12 months

Scope:

100%

Start date:

As agreed.

Application:

Please submit your application before deadline 18 September 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.title: Konstruktionsingeniør / Projektleder med erfaring i bæredygtigt byggeri
jobs.description:
På vegne af Werner Sobek København søger Gi Group en erfaren konstruktionsingeniør / projektleder, som ønsker at arbejde med transformation af det byggede miljø, komplekse konstruktioner og bæredygtige løsninger i et internationalt rådgivningsmiljø. 

Werner Sobek er en international rådgivende ingeniørvirksomhed med fokus på konstruktioner, bæredygtighed og integreret design. Virksomheden arbejder med at skabe bygninger og konstruktioner, der forener teknisk ekspertise, æstetik og ansvarlig ressourceanvendelse. Projekterne spænder fra ikoniske byggerier og højhuse til komplekse transformations- og renoveringsprojekter. 

Kontoret i København blev etableret i januar 2022 og spiller en central rolle i den bæredygtige udvikling af dansk byggeri. Werner Sobek er blandt andet en del af Leralliancen, hvor erfaringer fra tyske byggestandarder har bidraget til udviklingen af nye bæredygtige byggeløsninger. Derudover arbejder virksomheden med revitalisering af eksisterende bygninger og udviklingen af fremtidens klimavenlige byggerier. 

Som konstruktionsingeniør / projektleder bliver du en vigtig del af et højt specialiseret team, hvor du får ansvar for projektering og udvikling af bærende konstruktioner i både nationale og internationale projekter. Som konstruktionsingeniør vil du samtidigt få en central rolle i samarbejdet med kunder, arkitekter og øvrige rådgivere, samtidig med at du bidrager til udviklingen af innovative og bæredygtige løsninger. 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Projektering og dimensionering af bærende konstruktioner til nybyggeri, transformation og renovering. 

  • Projektledelse og koordinering af tværfaglige projekter i samarbejde med interne og eksterne interessenter. 

  • Udvikling af konstruktionsløsninger med fokus på bæredygtighed, materialeeffektivitet og CO₂-reduktion. 

  • Teknisk sparring med kunder, arkitekter og øvrige rådgivere gennem hele projektforløbet. 

  • Udvikling af konstruktionsløsninger til eksisterende og fredede bygninger. 

  • Sikre, at projekter lever op til gældende dansk byggelovgivning og myndighedskrav. 

  • Bidrage til udvikling af innovative løsninger og implementering af nye bæredygtige byggemetoder. 

  • Deltagelse i både danske og internationale projekter i et tværfagligt rådgivningsmiljø. 

Faglige kvalifikationer

  • Du er uddannet civilingeniør med speciale inden for bærende konstruktioner. 

  • Du har flere års erfaring som konstruktionsingeniør og med projektering af bærende konstruktioner. 

  • Du har en solid konstruktionsfaglig forståelse og stærke analytiske kompetencer. 

  • Du har interesse for bæredygtighed, CO₂-reduktion, materialeeffektivitet og cirkulært byggeri. 

  • Du taler og forstår dansk og engelsk.

jobs.title: Skiservicemedarbeider / Ski Service Technician
jobs.description:
For deg som er opptatt av presisjon, struktur og topp finish

Norefjell Skisenter styrker skiservice-teamet og søker en faglig sterk skiteknikker til vintersesongen.

Våre verksteder håndterer både høyvolum utleie og skiservice for gjester med høye krav til kvalitet. Vi søker deg som vil ha din base på Skistua, hvor verkstedet er utstyrt med en topp moderne Wintersteiger Discovery 2 i kombinasjon med Sigma BSI. Dette gir svært gode muligheter for presis struktur, jevn slip og effektiv produksjon – også i perioder med høyt trykk.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Strukturering, planslip og kantpreparering av alpinski og snowboard
  • Drift og vedlikehold av Wintersteiger-maskiner
  • Manuell etterbehandling og kvalitetskontroll

  • Kundedialog ved behov, spesielt på mer avanserte serviceoppdrag

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Erfaring fra skiserviceverksted
  • God forståelse for struktur, kantvinkler og såleoppbygging
  • Erfaring med Wintersteiger (eller tilsvarende maskiner) er en klar fordel
  • Evne til å jobbe nøyaktig og effektivt under høyt arbeidspress
  • Teknisk interesse og eierskap til eget arbeid

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et moderne verksted med maskinpark i toppklasse
  • Mulighet til å jobbe med avansert skiservice og høyt volum
  • Et faglig sterkt miljø med fokus på kvalitet og utvikling
  • Tett samarbeid med skiutleie

 

Er du detaljorientert, opptatt av presisjon – og motiveres av å levere ski med best mulig ytelse på snø?


Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For those who care about precision, structure and a flawless finish

Norefjell Ski Resort is strengthening its ski service team and is looking for a highly skilled ski technician for the winter season.

Our workshops handle both high-volume rental equipment and ski servicing for guests with high quality expectations. We are looking for someone who will be based at Skistua, where the workshop is equipped with a state-of-the-art Wintersteiger Discovery 2 combined with Sigma BSI. This provides excellent opportunities for precise structuring, consistent grinding and efficient production – even during periods of high demand.

Responsibilities:

Qualifications:

We offer:

  • A highly skilled team focused on quality and professional development
  • Close cooperation with the ski rental department

Are you detail-oriented, passionate about precision and motivated by delivering skis with the best possible performance on snow?

Then we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: People Partner - Netlight
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HR professional passionate about making a meaningful impact on both people and business? Do you excel at building relationships and serving as a trusted advisor to drive individual and organizational growth?

Netlight is seeking a People Partner for a fixed-term parental leave cover, starting in November 2026 and running until January 2028. This role is ideal for someone who focuses on operational excellence with a strategic approach and is eager to explore diverse opportunities for personal and career development.

About Netlight Netlight provides a full range of premium IT-consulting services at the forefront of the digital industry and stands out for its product- and technology-independent expertise in a wide range of industries and clients. It is a network organization of more than 2000 role models making aspiring digital leaders successful in their business-critical IT projects. The company has been awarded several times as a top employer, as well as for growth, continued profitability and engagement for diversity, equity, and equality within the IT industry. Today, Netlight is growing across Europe, currently with 11 active international offices. As a network organization, their way of working is based on leveraging competence, allowing them to benefit from collective expertise, beyond the ability of the individual. The company is built on trust and self-leadership.

The Team Netlight’s global HR organization includes 25+ colleagues across HR, Payroll, and Learning & Development. The HR Operations team in Stockholm consists of seven professionals, located atop Gallerian. As a key member of the team, the People Partner helps shape the future of HR, driving HR core deliveries, growth and success in an environment built on collaboration, trust, and development. Collaboration across the Global HR Team is central to ensure alignment and advance key initiatives.

The Role – People Partner Working in HR at Netlight requires strong business sense and exceptional relationship-building skills, as this is a fast-paced, ever-evolving, and people-focused organization. As a People Partner, the responsibilities include:

    

Managing employee relations and enhancing the employee experience throughout their journey.

    

Coaching, advising, and training leaders on key personnel topics—such as work environment, performance, well-being, and labor law—to empower them in their roles.

    

Supporting talent management initiatives to help our people reach their full potential.

    

Driving and leading projects with people and business impact

    

Ensuring HR policies and procedures align with our overall people strategy.

    

Driving efficient global HR practices while ensuring compliance with employment laws and regulations.

    

Managing and developing partnerships related to employee well-being and benefits.

    

Leading employee engagement efforts, including surveys and initiatives to assess and improve organizational well-being.

    

Handling people data across the employee lifecycle within our HRIS.

    

Utilizing People Analytics to analyze and share key insights that support informed decision-making and business strategy.

Profile

Netlight is looking for an HR professional with an open and creative mindset, eager to learn and apply their experience. The role suits someone who enjoys collaboration, takes initiative, and is committed to growth.

In addition, they value:

    

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex HR challenges.

    

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build trust and influence at all levels of the organization.

    

A proactive and solution-oriented approach to driving HR initiatives forward.

    

An understanding of HR best practices, employment laws, and compliance.

    

The ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a people-first mindset.

Qualifications

    

University degree with focus on Human Resources or similar education

    

3+ years of full-time work experience within the field of HR; Employee life cycle, advising leaders, developing processes and guidelines etc.

    

You communicate fluently verbally and in written form in Swedish and have a professional level of English (as English is our organizational language).

What Netlight Offers

    

The possibility to be part of and drive a wide array of HR and business topics in an international environment.

    

Competence development and long-term career progression realized through a culture of knowledge sharing, feedback, external courses, mentorship and coaching.

    

A top modern, and centrally located office space in Stockholm (Urban Escape on top of Gallerian).

    

Social- and competency developing internal events

The compensation and benefits package includes:

    

5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)

    

Private pension savings

    

30 days of paid vacation

    

Employee Assistance Program

    

Parental Top Up

    

Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)

When applying, you will be asked to answer a few brief questions and afterwards you will receive updates regarding any possible next step in the process 😊 If you have any questions about our process or this role, please contact Martina Kolga, Recruitment Consultant (073-3222502, martina.kolga@zoey.se). jobs.title: Lokalvårdare till storstädning - heltid 100 %
jobs.description:
Lokalvårdare till storstädning och engångsuppdrag – heltid 100 %

Optimal Trappstädning söker nu en ny medarbetare som vill arbeta heltid med storstädningar, extrastädningar och andra engångsuppdrag i Stockholmsområdet.

Det här passar dig som gillar ett praktiskt arbete, tycker om variation och vill ha en arbetsdag där du rör på dig och arbetar på olika platser.

Tjänsten är på heltid, 100 %.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som lokalvårdare hos oss kommer du främst att arbeta med uppdrag som inte ingår i den vanliga återkommande trappstädningen.

Arbetsuppgifterna kan till exempel bestå av:

    Storstädning
    Engångsstädning
    Extra beställda städinsatser
    Grundlig rengöring av trapphus och gemensamma ytor
    Städning inför eller efter särskilda händelser
    Andra tillfälliga städuppdrag hos våra kunder

Arbetet sker på olika adresser runt om i Stockholm och du kommer att köra mellan uppdragen under arbetsdagen.

Därför är B-körkort ett krav.

Automatkörkort är helt okej.

Du kommer både att arbeta tillsammans med kollegor och självständigt beroende på uppdragets storlek och typ.

Vi söker dig som

    Har B-körkort
    Är noggrann och ser detaljer
    Tar ansvar för ditt arbete
    Passar tider och är pålitlig
    Trivs med ett fysiskt arbete
    Kan arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra
    Är flexibel när arbetsdagen och uppdragen varierar
    Talar svenska eller engelska
    Vill arbeta heltid

Erfarenhet från städning är meriterande, men inte ett absolut krav.

För oss är det viktigare att du har rätt inställning, arbetar ordentligt och vill lära dig våra arbetssätt.

Vad du kan förvänta dig hos oss

Hos Optimal Trappstädning får du ett arbete där ingen dag behöver se exakt likadan ut.

Vi erbjuder:

    Heltidsarbete, 100 %
    Varierande arbetsdagar
    Arbete på olika platser i Stockholm
    Introduktion till våra rutiner och arbetsmetoder
    Möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor
    Ett företag där kvalitet och ansvar är viktigt

Om Optimal Trappstädning

Optimal Trappstädning arbetar med trappstädning och fastighetsnära städtjänster åt kunder runt om i Stockholm.

Vi vill att våra kunder ska kunna lita på att arbetet blir utfört ordentligt, på rätt tid och med hög kvalitet.

Därför söker vi personer som är ansvarstagande, noggranna och stolta över sitt arbete.

Ansökan

Skicka in din ansökan och berätta kort om:

    Vem du är
    Om du har arbetat med städning tidigare
    När du kan börja
    Att du har B-körkort

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Välkommen med din ansökan till Optimal Trappstädning!

🇬🇧 Full-time Cleaner for Deep Cleaning and One-Time Assignments – 100%

Optimal Trappstädning is looking for a new full-time employee to work with deep cleaning, extra cleaning and one-time cleaning assignments throughout the Stockholm area.

This position is suitable for someone who enjoys practical work, likes variety and prefers an active working day with different locations and assignments.

This is a full-time, 100% position.

Your Responsibilities

Your main responsibility will be cleaning assignments that are outside our regular recurring stairwell cleaning.

Your work may include:

    Deep cleaning
    One-time cleaning assignments
    Extra cleaning requested by customers
    Thorough cleaning of stairwells and common areas
    Cleaning before or after special events or projects
    Other temporary cleaning assignments

You will work at different locations around Stockholm and drive between assignments during the working day.

For this reason, a Category B driver's license is required.

An automatic-only driver's license is accepted.

Depending on the assignment, you may work together with colleagues or independently.

We Are Looking for Someone Who

    Has a Category B driver's license
    Is careful and pays attention to details
    Takes responsibility for their work
    Is reliable and punctual
    Enjoys physical and active work
    Can work independently as well as in a team
    Is flexible when assignments and daily schedules change
    Speaks Swedish or English
    Wants to work full-time

Previous cleaning experience is an advantage, but it is not required.

For us, the most important things are that you have a good attitude, work carefully and are willing to learn our way of working.

What We Offer

At Optimal Trappstädning, you will have a varied job where your working days can include different types of assignments and locations.

We offer:

    Full-time employment, 100%
    Varied working days
    Work at different locations around Stockholm
    Introduction to our routines and working methods
    The opportunity to work with experienced colleagues
    A workplace where quality and responsibility matter

About Optimal Trappstädning

Optimal Trappstädning provides stairwell cleaning and property-related cleaning services to customers throughout Stockholm.

Our goal is to provide reliable service and consistently high-quality cleaning.

We are therefore looking for employees who are responsible, careful and take pride in doing a good job.

Application

Please send us your application and briefly tell us:

    About yourself
    Whether you have previous cleaning experience
    When you are available to start
    That you have a Category B driver's license

Applications are reviewed continuously.

Welcome to apply and become part of Optimal Trappstädning!

jobs.title: Professor of large animal surgery
jobs.description:
Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Science

Department of Clinical Sciences

The Department of Clinical Sciences conducts undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the scientific areas of veterinary medicine and veterinary nursing. We contribute to the continuous development of knowledge about animal health and diseases at both individual and population levels.

The department's activities mainly concern our common Swedish domesticated animal species with a focus on anesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical pathology, medicine and animal reproduction. The University Animal Hospital is an integrated part of the Department of Clinical Sciences.

Read more about our activities and infrastructure https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/clinical-sciences/.



Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU via the following https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/.



Subject description

The subject is large animal surgery with a focus on horses but also includes ruminants and pigs.

Duties

The applicant will be expected to:

    develop and lead internationally successful research;
    develop, lead and participate in teaching at first, second and third cycle level;
    develop and maintain national and international networks with academia, the relevant public authorities, industry, organisations and society at large;
    collaborate with other SLU research teams to strengthen interdisciplinary activities at the university;
    apply for external research funding from both national and international sources;
    supervise doctoral students and residents undergoing specialist training;
    actively participate in clinical work and teaching;
    contribute to the strategic development of the department, faculty and SLU;
    communicate research findings and other relevant information to society at large;
    perform administrative duties within the department, faculty and university.

The department uses Swedish and English in parallel. The professor should be able to perform the majority of their tasks in English. However, as a public authority, the university has Swedish as its main language according to the requirements of the Language Act and the professor must be able to use Swedish as their working language within four years of beginning the position. The department will provide support with language learning.

Eligibility

The applicant must

    have a Degree of Master of Science in Veterinary Medicine;
    be licensed to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden, alternatively be entitled to obtain such a licence in accordance with the relevant legislation, regulations and directives*;
    have successfully completed a doctoral degree or have the equivalent academic qualifications, as well as hold the qualifications required for appointment as a docent;
    demonstrate research expertise in the subject;
    demonstrate teaching expertise and have the ability to integrate research and a scientific approach into their teaching;
    have proven clinical experience in a subject field relevant to the position;
    have good knowledge of English.

*Act (https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/lag-2009302-om-verksamhet-inom-djurens-halso-_sfs-2009-302#K3) on Activities within Animal Healthcare, Chapter 3. Eligibility regulations.

jobs.title: Produktionsleder med energi og lyst til at gøre en forskel hos Elfac A/S
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for mennesker, produktion og udvikling?

Hos Elfac handler produktion om mere end maskiner, processer og leveringstider.


Det handler om mennesker. Om samarbejde. Om faglighed. Og om hele tiden at finde nye måder at gøre tingene lidt bedre på.


Vi har korte kommandoveje, en flad organisation og arbejder tæt sammen i hverdagen. Her er der ikke langt fra idé til handling – og som vores nye Produktionsleder får du mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på både produktionen og din egen fremtid.
Vi er i udvikling og vi håber, du har lyst til at være med!

Din vigtigste opgave? At skabe godt flow.

Som Produktionsleder bliver du en central del af den daglige drift og udvikling af vores produktion.
Du skal naturligvis sikre, at kvalitet, levering og planlægning fungerer. Men mindst lige så vigtigt bliver det, at du kan samle og motivere mennesker.
Hos os arbejder mange forskellige personligheder og fagligheder sammen. Derfor leder vi efter en synlig og nærværende leder, der kan kommunikere med mennesker, skabe tillid og få teamet til at arbejde i samme retning. Du ved, at godt produktionsflow ikke kun handler om processer.

Det handler også om mennesker.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Lede og motivere medarbejderne i produktionen

  • Sikre et godt flow og en effektiv hverdag

  • Arbejde med kvalitet, levering og løbende forbedringer

  • Optimere processer og arbejdsgange

  • Skabe struktur og overblik

  • Være synlig og nærværende i produktionen

  • Bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af Elfac

Du har teknisk forståelse – og mennesker betyder noget for dig

Du kommer måske fra en stilling som produktionsleder, værkfører, teamleder eller lignende. Det vigtigste er ikke din titel.
Det vigtigste er, at du har erfaring fra produktion og forstår, hvad der skal til for at skabe et velfungerende flow.
Du har teknisk forståelse og gerne flair for håndværket. Samtidig har du lyst til at arbejde med mennesker og motiveres af at få både medarbejdere og produktion til at udvikle sig.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en produktionsvirksomhed

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller et naturligt lederskab

  • Har teknisk forståelse og flair for produktion

  • Kan skabe struktur og overblik

  • Trives med mange forskellige typer mennesker

  • Har energi og lyst til at gøre tingene bedre

  • Er en leder, der går foran – og samtidig står sammen med dit team

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

Vi kan tilbyde dig en spændende lederrolle i en virksomhed, hvor du får mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel.
Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab med dygtige kolleger, høj faglighed og en kultur, hvor vi vil hinanden.

Hos Elfac får du:

  • Korte kommandoveje og en flad organisation

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og ledelse

  • Stor mulighed for indflydelse

  • En hverdag tæt på produktionen og menneskerne

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Frihed til at sætte dit eget præg på rollen og din fremtid

Vi søger ikke bare en leder, der kan holde produktionen i gang.
Vi søger en person med energi, ambitioner og lyst til at være med til at gøre en forskel.

Er det dig?

Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.
EliteRekruttering varetager rekrutteringsprocessen

Men har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Operations manager Maria Steenberg Jessen på:
Mail: msj@elfac.dk Telefon: 22 62 86 82

Elfac A/S

Elfac er Danmarks førende underleverandør af ledningskonfektion og forbindelsesteknik og har p.t. 100 medarbejdere. Hos Elfac lægges der vægt på rummelighed og et godt fysisk arbejdsmiljø,samtidig med at der fokuseres på leveringssikkerhed, kvalitet og effektivitet i alle led. Hos Elfac har vi én – og kun én – målsætning: at sikre vores kunder den helt rigtige løsning.

Derfor arbejder vi udfra metoden The Elfac Way, der ganske enkelt består af tre faser DEFINE – DESIGN – DELIVER. Elfacer beliggende i Silkeborg, ejet af den svenske koncern Lagercrantz Group AB.

jobs.title: Kitchen assistant, kitchen help - or trained chef
jobs.description:
Attention ladies & gents in Aarhus, or close by  

We are looking for a chef - kitchen assistant or kitchenhelp to our french bistro.

We are 2 small and very cozy restaurants in Jægergårdsgade, Århus, Denmark. And we are pleasantly busy.  

Cheers to the idea that YOU might be one of our new colleagues. We have an ongoing view on all applicants and we welcome new colleagues, when needed. Feel free to send an application to us.

We urge you to go to our SoMe, read about us and see photos of what type of service we do, to get a feel for the atmosphere and the culture we have.

Klassisk Bistro 65, being the characteristic charming French bistro   https://www.klassiskbistro.dk/

Who we are;

We are a wonderful diverse team in nationalities and cultures, around 50 colleagues that come from 12-13 different countries, all over the world - Italy, France, Argentina, UK, Bulgaria, Syria, Slovenia, Poland, Nepal, Russia, DK …. Our spoken language is English with a touch of dialect, charming and very relaxed. 

We are down to earth in mindset and working style, the organisation is flat in structure – so there’s no managers to tell you what to do every 10 minutes, thus we expect you to work independently, focused on your tasks and responsibilities and with an eye for the whole team.

We are looking for the following staff;

Experienced chefs, that have years behind a stow and is used to busy and high pressure service. You are able to keep calm, move fast, make nice food & keep kitchen clean – also when everything is hectic around you. 

Kitchen help, that have min. 6 months experience working in kitchens, helping out with prep for service as well as helping out as a waiter. You are willing to do a lot of helpful stuff when getting ready for service.

We ask of you;

Tattoos, multi-colored trousers, straight hair, no hair, A, B, C, D chest seize, flip beard, mustacho or too much beard…..  We don’t really mind - as long as you have a big smile, are clean, outgoing, service minded, a good helpful colleague, willing to learn new stuff and can move fast in our kitchen. 

Please understand, our team are hardworking people, if you have an addiction problem with drugs, alcohol etc. - you do not need to apply to any of the positions! Its one of our non-negotiables and a key company values.

Acknowledging the importance in following the company rules and guidelines, eg. for best practice in ´cleaning & hygiene´ – is another key factor in our company. We expect of you to be responsible and meet on time and not report sick every second day due to hangovers.

We offer;

·       A lively and nice place to work, no days are alike

·       Salary linked to qualifications (all staff are hourly paid)

·       We teach you, first 3-5 shifts are trial shifts - and you get paid for these too

·       Chance to expand your competencies  

·       Staff food

·       50% discount on your bill for 4 pax, if you eat in the restaurants on certain days

·       Staff trips and staff events over the year – e.g. Ice skating, Tivoli

·       Maybe you join our restaurant Smukfisk at SmukFest festival in Skanderborg

·       Chance to participate in Danish Oyester Cup, when we attend this event

International students that only can work 10-15 hours/week are also welcome. 

Only apply for the job, if you live close by and are able to come to work and stay untill your shift ends at night. Its a non-negotiable.

Please note, getting a job in one of our places is subject to a valid Danish work permit and Danish bank account. So you must be able to get a CPR number (personal identification number ) and a work permit in Denmark.

Please send an e-mail to info@jobsaka.dk with your; application - photo, - and please inform us about where in the process your are, regarding obtaining a Danish work permit.

Header in e-mail MUST clearly state; the job role & if you seek parttime or full time.

If your headder is not displaying this, your applications will not be taken into account, thanks.

jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, Electricity Markets and Flexibility (Electrical Engineering) - 2 positions
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking two motivated and talented Project Researchers or Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded Electricity Markets and Flexibility project.

The positions are full-time and fixed-term for three (3) years. The preferred starting date is flexible but agreed together as soon as possible. The positions are located in the School of Technology and Innovations and under electrical engineering discipline. The positions are located in Vaasa.

Background

The Electricity Markets and Flexibility project investigates how electricity markets must be designed, and how demand-side flexibility must be mobilised, for a power system dominated by variable renewable generation to remain reliable and affordable.

The project combines quantitative modelling of markets and the wider energy system with empirical analysis of how flexibility is created, priced, and traded by market participants. A central objective is to understand the interaction between market design choices and the total cost of the energy system, and to quantify the value of flexible demand, including the rapidly growing load from data centres, to system operation, investment, and consumers.

The project will produce new knowledge on electricity market design, system-level cost assessment, and demand-side flexibility, as well as new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilised in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

The two positions are divided between two closely connected research themes. Decided theme is chosen depending on the profiles of the selected candidates.

Theme A: Electricity market design and the cost of the whole energy system

Research on this theme addresses the design of wholesale, balancing, reserve, and capacity markets under high shares of variable renewable generation; price formation, scarcity pricing, and locational signals; network charging and cost allocation; and sector coupling with heat and transport. The work involves system-level modelling of investment and operation to assess how alternative market designs affect the total cost of the energy system, security of supply, and the distribution of costs and benefits among market participants.

Theme B: Power system flexibility in data centres

Research on this theme addresses large data centres as controllable electricity loads. Topics include temporal and spatial shifting of computing workloads, the use of on-site energy storage and backup capacity, thermal flexibility and waste heat recovery, participation in wholesale, balancing, and reserve markets, grid connection and connection agreements, and the techno-economic and business case assessment of flexible operation. The work spans the modelling of data centre flexibility potential and its valuation from the perspectives of the operator, the system operator, and society.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasises the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research within one of the projects research themes.
- Develop, apply, and document quantitative models and analyses of electricity markets, energy systems, or flexible demand.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, system operators, energy companies, technology providers, and data centre operators.
- Participate in data collection, analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

We expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills, including programming or modelling experience.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.
- Excellent communication skills in English.

Desirable:

- Experience with energy system, power system, or electricity market modelling, and with the associated software and programming environments.
- Experience with optimisation, simulation, econometrics, or data analysis applied to energy or market data.
- Knowledge of data centre operations, computing infrastructure, or ICT energy use (Theme B).

Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en économie, management, gestion d'entreprises, gestion de projet, transformation digitale, ingénierie ou de son équivalent. jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. jobs.title: Chargé de la visibilité et de la valorisation des équipes éducatives et psycho-sociales des lycées (m/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Centre psycho-social et d'accompagnement scolaires (CePAS) Missions Missions : Les équipes éducatives et psycho-sociales des lycées jouent un rôle essentiel dans l'accompagnement éducatif, psychologique et social des dynamiques et de leurs familles. Pourtant, leurs missions, expertises et les services qu'elles proposent ne sont pas toujours suffisamment connus ou compris. Dans ce contexte, une communication claire, cohérente et accessible constitue un levier essentiel pour renforcer leur visibilité et en faciliter le recours ; Rattaché au Service Communication du CePAS, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Centre de ressources et les professionnels des lycées afin de développer une communication institutionnelle cohérente, centrée sur les besoins des dynamiques, des familles et des partenaires. Par la conception et la mise en place de stratégies, de campagnes et de contenus de communication, vous contribuez ainsi à renforcer la visibilité et la compréhension des missions des Services psycho-sociaux et d'accompagnement scolaires (SePAS), des Services socio-éducatifs (SSE) et des internats scolaires, tout en valorisant les expertises des professionnels de terrain et les actions de prévention. Dans ce contexte, vous serez notamment amené à : Développer la visibilité et la compréhension des services ; Contribuer à la mise en œuvre d'actions de communication visant à renforcer la connaissance et la compréhension des services ; Concevoir des supports d'information facilitant l'identification des missions et des ressources disponibles ; Valoriser les projets, initiatives et bonnes pratiques développés dans les établissements scolaires ; Mettre en lumier/ière les métiers et expertises des professionnels à travers des contenus éditoriaux variés (portraits, interviews, témoignages, vidéos etc.).
