jobs.title: Senior Level Designer
jobs.description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n
$115,000 - $149,500 a year
\n

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.



This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.



You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.



The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Web Infrastructure team builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients, including client architecture, performance, reliability, and shared design systems.

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the team through the evolution from Notion Clients. You’ll set strategy, develop senior engineers and managers, and partner across Notion to make the product faster, more reliable, and easier to build.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - You'll build and manage a diverse and inclusive team of engineers and managers working on core parts of Notion's architecture. You'll create a healthy environment in your team that embodies Notion's values.

 - You'll facilitate planning—the prioritization, sequencing, and staffing of work—for your team.

 - You'll be responsible for maintaining a high-quality bar for everything your team ships.

 - You'll own execution in your team to develop a steady cadence of delivering value to your users.

 - You'll work with others to shape how Notion's engineering organization works. You'll help develop our technical practices, recruiting and onboarding strategy, planning and prioritization process, and more.

 - You have managed senior engineering teams and managers, and have experience in scaling teams.

 - You have built, or are committed to building, diverse and inclusive teams.

 - You create team environments that are at once collaborative, empowering, supportive, and challenging—ones where engineers do their best work.

 - You have a sufficiently deep background in product and technology that you can ask the right questions of your team, balance product, tech, and people concerns, and make hard tradeoffs.

 - You think rigorously. You're prepared to tackle the toughest technical problems, understand trade-offs, and enable teams to make decisions and progress.

 - You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and change, especially around organizational structure and the boundaries of your role. You enjoy jumping into whatever areas need attention and learning as-you-go.

 - You value empathetic and direct communication, particularly when giving and receiving feedback.

 - You have managed engineering teams at startups before, particularly during periods of rapid growth and organizational change.

 - You have experience rolling out engineering and management practices and processes—e.g., code review, performance reviews, and levels and ladders—where they didn't exist before.

 - You've managed teams that are across multiple offices.

jobs.title: Systemadministrator til udvikling og drift af robuste integrationer
jobs.description:
Kan du få systemer, data og forretningsbehov til at hænge sammen? Har du stærke kompetencer i PowerShell, blik for API'er og lyst til at skabe robuste integrationer i et miljø, hvor Microsoft-teknologier fylder meget? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Team IT i Digital og Analyse.

Vi søger en ny kollega, som sammen med resten af teamet vil sikre, at vores systemer kan udveksle data og integreres gennem relevante grænseflader. Du får en central rolle i at skabe overblik over, hvilke data der findes i de enkelte systemer, og i at vurdere, hvordan data kan anvendes sikkert og meningsfuldt på tværs af organisationen, samtidig med de altid er opdaterede.

Din profil
Vi søger dig, der arbejder struktureret og nøjagtigt med integrationer og har både teknisk nysgerrighed og forståelse for data. Du kan sætte dig ind i komplekse systemlandskaber, omsætte behov til holdbare løsninger og dokumentere dit arbejde, så også kollegerne i driften kan medvirke til høj oppetid.

Samtidig formår du at udnytte AI som udviklingsværktøj og støtte til hurtigt at afprøve idéer og nye integrationer - uden at gå på kompromis med kvalitet, sikkerhed og grundig validering. Du tager ansvar, følger opgaverne helt til dørs og trives med at løse opgaver i tæt samarbejde med kolleger i både Team IT og resten af afdelingen.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:
  • har stærke kompetencer i PowerShell og erfaring med at udvikle, vedligeholde og fejlfinde scripts
  • har erfaring med systemintegrationer og anvendelse af API'er
  • kan skabe overblik over datakilder, datamodeller og dataflows på tværs af systemer
  • som minimum har kendskab til C#, men også gerne andre programmeringssprog og -værktøjer
  • arbejder nøjagtigt og systematisk med dokumentation, versionsstyring, test og driftsstabilitet
  • kan anvende AI til hurtigt at udvikle og teste idéer til scripts og integrationer og samtidig forholde dig kritisk til resultatet
  • har blik for, hvordan scripts og integrationer skal overvåges, dokumenteres og indrettes, så systemadministratorerne kan drifte dem sikkert og effektivt i hverdagen
  • kan samarbejde med både tekniske specialister og kolleger med fokus på data og forretning.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med SQL, Microsoft Fabric eller SharePoint - herunder særligt integrationer til disse. Kendskab til identitets- og adgangsstyring (IDM) samt Microsofts øvrige cloud- og platformsteknologier vil også være relevant.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Din vigtigste opgave bliver at udvikle og vedligeholde sammenhængen mellem Absalons systemer og data. Du bliver en central teknisk sparringspartner, når nye integrationer skal designes, eksisterende integrationer skal forbedres, og data skal stilles til rådighed for nye formål.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:
  • udvikle, vedligeholde og overvåge integrationer mellem Absalons systemer via relevante API'er
  • have et særligt ansvar for drift og videreudvikling af vores IDM-løsning, som primært er bygget op omkring en række PowerShell-scripts
  • kortlægge, dokumentere og vedligeholde overblik over data i de enkelte systemer
  • medvirke til automatisering af en del af vores driftsopgaver
  • vurdere, hvordan data kan anvendes og deles på tværs af systemer med fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og stabil drift
  • samarbejde med Team Data og Analyse om at integrere data fra forskellige systemer til Microsoft Fabric
  • udvikle og vedligeholde integrationer til SharePoint, blandt andet i relation til vores ESDH-system
  • fejlfinde på dataflows, scripts og integrationer samt sikre overvågning og relevant dokumentation
  • bidrage til valg af tekniske løsninger og standarder i et miljø, der i høj grad er baseret på Microsoft-teknologier
  • dele viden og bidrage til, at løsningerne kan driftes og videreudvikles af flere i teamet.

Dine kolleger
I Digital og Analyse er vi 26 medarbejdere fordelt på 3 teams, der brænder for at lave gode digitale løsninger til hele Absalon. Vi har et bredt katalog af services og kompetencer i brugersupport, netværk, systemudvikling, projektledelse, didaktik, læringsteknologier, digitalisering, rapportering, analyser med mere.

Vi anstrenger os for at være servicemindede og kompetente partnere i alt, hvad vi laver. Vi har en uhøjtidelig omgangsform og vores lattermuskler er veltrænede. Vi nyder gerne kage, men vi har også en sund og varieret kantineordning og mulighed for at træne i vores fitnesslokale eller bare på de mange trapper, der er på campus. Vi bor på Absalons nye campus lige ved Slagelse station, og du vil få en af Slagelses bedste udsigter fra dit skrivebord.

Stillingen hører til i Team IT, hvis primære ansvarsområder er server- og netværksdrift, devicehåndtering, support, integrationer, informationssikkerhed m.v.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest den 1. november 2026
  • Afhængigt af din anciennitet og uddannelsesbaggrund vil en forventet løn ligge mellem 40.000 kr. og 50.000 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension. Hertil kommer der et pensionsbidrag på 16,68% eller 18,07% afhængig af din uddannelsesbaggrund.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Brian Andersen på telefon 7248 3037 eller bran@pha.dk.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/om-professionshoejskolen-absalon/ledige-stillinger/ eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 16. september 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale den 21. september og evt. 2. samtale den 25. september.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Plumber / Plumbing Installer - Plumbing & Heating - Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Bang's VVS is looking for one qualified and experienced plumber / plumbing installer to join our team on Lolland, Denmark.

You'll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit. Unfortunately, we're not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will carry out varied plumbing work for private customers, businesses, industry and construction projects on Lolland.

We are looking for someone who:

Is a qualified plumber with relevant vocational training
Has practical experience as a plumber
Can work independently and deliver high-quality work
Is service-minded and comfortable working with customers
Can communicate in English
Has a category B driving licence
Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

What we offer

Gross hourly wage: DKK 180-220, depending on qualifications and experience
Candidates with several years of relevant experience can expect a salary at the higher end of the range
Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Pension scheme
5 weeks of vacation
Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension
Company vehicle
Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bang's VVS

Bang's VVS is an authorised Danish plumbing and sheet metal company established in 2016.

The company works with private customers, businesses, industry, agriculture and construction projects and handles both small and large projects. Bang's VVS places strong emphasis on quality workmanship, good customer service and energy-efficient solutions.

You will join an informal workplace with good colleagues, a high degree of independence and a strong focus on quality workmanship.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application to:

rekruttering@lolland.dk

Please write "Bang's VVS" in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe's largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit https://newcomers.lolland.dk/

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on, and people-focused Warehouse Supervisor to work alongside the Warehouse Manager in leading and managing our warehouse operations. The Warehouse Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operation of the warehouse, ensuring the efficient receipt, storage, preparation, and dispatch of fresh produce. The role involves supervising warehouse staff, maintaining food safety standards, managing stock levels, and ensuring all inbound and outbound deliveries are processed accurately and on time. Key Responsibilities Warehouse Operations • Support the Warehouse Manager in the daily operation of the warehouse. • Ensure stock is received, stored, rotated, and managed correctly using FIFO principles. • Monitor warehouse productivity and identify opportunities for operational improvement. • Ensure customer orders are picked, checked, packed, and dispatched accurately and on time. • Maintain high standards of housekeeping, organisation, and warehouse efficiency. • Ensure all areas are operating in line with customer requirements and company standards. Team Leadership • Lead, motivate, and develop warehouse operatives to achieve operational targets. • Assist the Warehouse Manager with recruitment, onboarding, training, and performance management activities. • Monitor employee attendance, timekeeping, productivity, and adherence to company procedures. • Deputise for the Warehouse Manager during periods of absence. • Assist with labour planning, shift scheduling, and resource allocation. • Support warehouse audits, stocktakes, and continuous improvement initiatives. • Provide regular updates on operational performance, staffing issues, and warehouse challenges. Deliveries & Logistics • Coordinate inbound supplier deliveries and outbound customer deliveries. • Investigate delivery discrepancies and implement corrective actions where necessary. • Coordinate the movement of raw vegetables into the preparation area. • Work closely with Production, Purchasing, and Transport teams to meet daily customer requirements and deadlines. • Ensure vehicles are loaded safely, accurately, and efficiently. • Maintain high standards of product quality, presentation, and customer specification compliance. • Minimise picking errors, product damage, and customer complaints. Food Safety & Compliance • Ensure HACCP, hygiene, temperature control, traceability, and quality procedures are followed at all times. Health, Safety & Compliance • Ensure compliance with all company health, safety, and food safety procedures. • Promote a strong safety culture throughout the operation. • Conduct regular workplace inspections and safety audits. • Address safety concerns and hazards promptly. Stock Control & Administration • Carry out regular stock checks and investigate discrepancies. • Monitor stock levels and communicate shortages to relevant departments. • Monitor waste and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve efficiency.

jobs.title: Socialpædagog søges til Børne- og ungehjem
jobs.description:
Behandlingsinstitutioner Curam søger snarest en socialpædagog til afdeling Grønnebjerg

Curams målgruppe er børn og unge mellem 14-23 år med multiple problemstillinger, herunder omsorgssvigt, udviklingstraume, tilknytningsforstyrrelser, kriminalitet og misbrug. Vi har plads til i alt 15 unge, fordelt på 3 afdelinger, ligesom vi har ansvaret for 4 unge der bor i egen bolig, alle i Skibby. Stillingen er ledig i vores afdeling Grønnebjerg i Kirke Såby, og har plads til 5 unge mellem 14-17 år.

Arbejdestiden er mellem 7.00-23.00 i et 4 ugers rul, og laves i samarbejde med de øvrige ansatte. Man skal være indstillet på at arbejde 2-4 eftermiddag/after pr uge og mindst en weekend (fredag/lørdag eller lørdag/søndag) pr. måned. Natarbejde kommer ikke på tale, da vi har faste nattevagter.

Ansøger med kendskab til arbejdet med udsatte børn og unge vil blive foretrukket, ligesom kendskab til misbrugsproblematikker og udadreagerende adfærd er en klar fordel.

Robusthed, ro, empati og mentaliseringskompetncer, er sammen med en respektfuld og anerkendende tilgang til målgruppen og dennes familie, nødvendige kompetencer.

Ansvarlighed og ordentlighed er en forudsætning, ligesom humor og samarbejdsevne er centrale elementer for den rette ansøger. 

Vi tilbyder god løn, oplæring, kurser og supervision, ligesom der er tilrettelagt en 1-årig intern efteruddannelse for den samlede personalegruppe med opstart maj 2026. Desuden vægter vi en god omgangstone, frihed under ansvar, kollegial sparring og har nogle super gode fysiske rammer, både til personalet og de unge.

Vi arbejder ud fra en tilknytningsteoretisk, systemisk narrativ og kropsorienteret tilgang.

Værdigrundlag:

  • Vi tror på, at alle børn og unge har ressourcer og styrker og alle gør det bedst de kan.

  • Vi tror på, at enhver person har ret til at blive behandlet individuelt ud fra en særligt tilrettelagt og målrettet behandlingstænkning, der tager højde for barnet/den unges livshistorie, følelsesmæssige samt kognitive forudsætninger for at kunne indgå i kontakt og relation med sin omverden.

  • Vi tror på, at professionelle, som er autentiske, træder i karakter, og som ikke er bange for at involvere sig og sætte sig selv i spil, kan gøre en forskel.

  • Vi tror på, at positive forandringer bedst skabes i et positivt defineret felt. Vi tager altid udgangspunkt i det enkelte menneske og lægger vægt på, at alle bliver mødt med en forståelse for de vanskeligheder barnet/den unge har med sig.

  • Vi tror på, at en helhedsorienteret tilgang, hvor hele netværker inddrages, er den bedste forudsætning for forandring, der også holder på længere sigt.

Kørsel i egen bil kan i nødstilfælde være nødvendigt, hvis alle Curams biler er optaget.

Med venlig hilsen

Flemming Zuschlag Christihansen

Aut. psykolog og forstander

jobs.title: Metal Fabricator
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
O’Carroll Engineering is an innovative, off-site modular engineering steel fabrication specialist. Established in 1990 we combine a highly skilled workforce with technologically advanced and digital fabrication methods to produce efficient-install solutions to industrial and construction markets. Specialists in modular walkways and access systems, stairs and modular apartment balconies. O’Carroll Engineering is offering an opportunity to join our 165+ strong, highly skilled team and be a part of an innovative, technology-driven, industry-leading manufacturer. Our team members are at the core of our growth and we endeavour to strike the best possible work-life balance along with training and advancement opportunities to ensure we challenge and motivate employees. Located in one of Ireland's most vibrant and scenic towns Killarney, we are proud that the majority of our staff have over five years of service with us. For more information visit www.ocarrollengineering.com. We are expanding our innovative, award-winning team and currently seeking a Metal Fabricator. The Metal Fabricator is part of the team of Fabrication Technicians, Metal Fabricators and Welders who fit and weld steel components. The Metal Fabricator will primarily work from technical drawings to fabricate, fit and tack weld competent parts before the item is moved on for welding. jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Director, Product Design to lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, reporting to the Co-Founder & Head of Design.

This is a true player-coach role for someone who loves building products as much as leading people. You'll lead and develop a talented team of product designers while remaining deeply embedded in the work itself. You'll whiteboard with designers, navigate complex product decisions.

The Co-Founder & Head of Design remains closely involved in design critique and product quality. Your role is to lead the day-to-day design organization by creating the structure, alignment, and momentum that enable exceptional work. You'll stay two to three layers deeper than the Co-Founder & Head of Design on active initiatives, surfacing the context, tradeoffs, and insights needed to make thoughtful decisions without requiring constant immersion in every project.

Success in this role requires exceptional product judgment, strong design taste, technical fluency, and a collaborative approach. You're someone who naturally connects disciplines, elevates the people around you, and makes both the work and the team better every day.

 
 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, ensuring work is aligned, prioritized, and delivered to an exceptionally high standard.

 - Manage, mentor, and develop a team of product designers, helping them grow their craft, confidence, and impact.

 - Shape and elevate the customer journey

 - Work alongside designers every day by whiteboarding ideas, exploring alternatives, reviewing work in progress, and solving complex product and interaction challenges.

 - Stay deeply informed across active initiatives, surfacing the context and insights that enable the Co-Founder & Head of Design to engage quickly in meaningful design critique and high-impact product decisions.

 - Raise the quality of product design through thoughtful feedback, exceptional craft, and strong design taste.

 - Help evolve Replit's design practices, workflows, and team culture while preserving the speed and flexibility of a high-growth company.

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard exceptional product design talent as the organization grows.

 
 


WHO YOU ARE

You're a builder first and a manager second.

You enjoy being close to the work, helping designers think through difficult problems, and making good teams even better. You're equally comfortable sketching ideas on a whiteboard, giving thoughtful design feedback, coaching a designer through a difficult challenge, or partnering with engineering on implementation details.

You combine exceptional product judgment with strong design taste and technical fluency. You're collaborative, humble, curious, and energized by helping great work happen.

 
 


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience leading product design teams within high-growth technology companies.

 - Proven ability to balance people leadership with meaningful hands-on product design contribution.

 - A portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft, interaction design, product thinking, and systems thinking.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to deliver technically sophisticated products.

 - Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development in fast-moving environments.

 - Exceptional communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

 - Strong design taste, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - Experience simplifying complex technical products into elegant, approachable user experiences.

 
 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing developer tools, technical products, or software creation platforms.

 - Experience building AI-powered products or AI-native workflows.

 - Coding experience or strong technical curiosity.

 - Experience growing design teams in startup or scale-up environments.

 - Active use of AI throughout your design process.

 
 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

This isn't a traditional design leadership role.

We're looking for someone who thrives in the work, not above it. Someone who enjoys solving problems alongside designers, building strong partnerships across Product and Engineering, and bringing the depth of context that allows the Co-Founder & Head of Design to focus on the moments where their perspective has the greatest impact.

This is a role for someone who is excited by complex product challenges, passionate about developing exceptional designers, and motivated by building products that make powerful technology feel intuitive.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

Experience transferring complex hardware products from engineering builds through pre-series and into repeatable production Hands-on experience with industrialisation, production ramp-ups, assembly, integration and testing Strong understanding of production workflows, manufacturing-process development, test infrastructure and production readiness Experience defining production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures and equipment requirements Experience introducing work instructions, routings, production records, traceability and configuration controls Experience with production planning, capacity analysis, inventory management, material flow and ERP/MRP systems Experience developing make-or-buy strategies and managing specialised suppliers or contract manufacturers Knowledge of structured production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 or an equivalent framework Understanding of non-conformance management, corrective actions and controlled engineering changes Experience building, leading and developing manufacturing or operations teams Ability to demonstrate your personal contribution and measurable results from previous industrialisation or production scale-up work Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and hands-on levels Strong cross-functional coordination, prioritisation and problem-solving skills A builder’s mindset and motivation to create new manufacturing capability Professional fluency in English Willingness to reside in Estonia and work primarily onsite in Tallinn Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate results such as establishing a production facility, transferring hardware into serial production, increasing capacity or throughput, improving quality and delivery performance, implementing manufacturing systems, developing test infrastructure, qualifying suppliers or building a production team.

Develop, maintain and improve RTL modules in VHDL Implement high-speed digital logic for communication systems Create simulations and testbenches to verify RTL behaviour Verify and validate designs against technical and system requirements Use Quartus, GHDL and GTKWave as part of the development and verification workflow Investigate and resolve RTL, integration and system-level issues Maintain clear code documentation and verification records Debug and validate FPGA designs on physical hardware Support board bring-up and hardware integration Work with LVDS, Ethernet and other high-speed digital interfaces Support integration between Altera FPGAs and STM32 microcontrollers through CAN interfaces Use laboratory equipment, including high-speed oscilloscopes, power supplies and multimeters Support system-level testing, verification and product qualification Contribute to the integration of custom software-defined radio functionality Work closely with electronics, embedded software and systems engineers Coordinate with electronics engineers on FPGA pinout integration and chip interconnections Translate system and communication requirements into practical RTL implementations Maintain FPGA architecture, interface, verification and code documentation Provide practical input into the development and improvement of the communication system

Other requirements: Requirements:
A bachelor’s degree in electronics, computer engineering, telecommunications or another relevant technical field At least one year of practical RTL or FPGA development experience Practical experience with RTL design in VHDL Experience maintaining, improving and developing RTL modules Experience creating and using simulations and testbenches Experience debugging FPGA designs on physical hardware Experience designing long, high-speed processing pipelines Understanding of clock recovery and high-speed digital data paths Understanding of digital communication systems and network protocol layers Familiarity with FPGA-based communication interfaces Ability to use technical documentation, electronic schematics and component datasheets A structured approach to verification, debugging and technical documentation Ability to work independently while recognising when collaboration or support is needed Readiness to work in a startup environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve Professional working proficiency in English at C1 level or equivalent University or personal projects may be considered as relevant experience when they include substantial FPGA-based development, such as developing a software-defined radio or a similarly complex system. jobs.title: Barselsvikar som idrætskoordinator i socialpsykiatrien
jobs.description:
Så er chancen her for at blive vores nye idrætskoordinator i en periode. Vores nuværende idrætskoordinator skal på barsel og vi søger derfor hendes afløser i perioden fra d 1-11 2026 til forventelig sommer 2027.

Har du erfaring med idræt og brænder du for at udvikle fællesskaber for mennesker med psykiske sårbarheder?

Du vil være en del af socialpsykiatrien, som består af et bofællesskab, et midlertidigt botilbud for unge samt dagsbeskæftigelse, bostøtte og café. Derudover er der et senhjerneskadeområde ligeledes med dagsbeskæftigelse og bostøtte.

Idrætskoordinatoren skal dække ovenstående områder.

Derudover har psykiatrien en meget velfungerende idrætsforening, LIF, - Limfjordens idrætsforening. Foreningen blev stiftet i september 2015 med henblik på at skabe et meningsfuldt og aktivt fællesskab for psykisk sårbare borgere i Morsø kommune. Foreningen er under Dansk Arbejder Idræt og har et samarbejde med Idræt for Sindet foreninger i hele Danmark.

Som Idrætskoordinator skal du arbejde tæt sammen tæt med bestyrelsen i idrætsforeningen om at arrangere aktiviteter og arrangementer både lokalt og ved deltagelse i idrætsarrangementer/stævner i andre kommuner sammen med borgerne.

Som idrætskoordinator bliver du både koordinator, igangsætter, instruktør og støtteperson i foreningen. Der vil også være praktiske opgaver og der vil være administrative opgaver i forhold til driften af LIF.

Fagligt forventer vi, at du;

  • Har en idrætsprofil og en relevant uddannelse, som f.eks pædagog, fysioterapeut, ergoterapeut, lærer eller har en uddannelse indenfor idræt og sundhed eller tilsvarende
  • Har erfaring med frivillige foreninger, enten som træner, instruktør eller lignende og kan indgå i samarbejde med frivillige foreninger
  • Evner at tilpasse din træning og instruktion efter deltagernes niveau og særligt i forhold til ikke idrætsvante mennesker
  • Har erfaring med eller viden om de udfordringer, psykisk sårbare mennesker har i dagligdagen
  • Har erfaring med at motivere andre

Vi forestiller os, at du som person:

  • Er engageret og empatisk og vil møde borgerne med et åbent og anerkendende sind
  • Har et godt og smittende humør
  • Har en indfaldsvinkel, der er motiverende, støttende og inspirerende for den enkelte
  • Har forståelse for forskelligheden båret af respekt for andre
  • Er rolig og tydelig i din kommunikation
  • Brænder for at gøre en forskel
  • Er selvstændig og kan tage ansvar
  • Har det fint med, at mange timer og aktiviteter kan ligge efter kl. 16
  • Kan samarbejde tværfagligt med kollegaer på alle område

 

Vores mission er at styrke borgernes mestring i eget liv, i samspil med det omgivende samfund, så vi bidrager til øget inklusion. Det handler både om at skabe tryghed for borgeren og øget selvstændighed. Vores indsats baserer sig på at møde den enkelte borger, via den nære og anerkendende relation, samt tage udgangspunkt i dennes kompetencer. 

 

Løn- og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst. Desuden fastsættes lønnen efter aftale og under medvirken af den forhandlingsberettede organisation.

For yderligere oplysninger eller spørgsmål kontakt leder Inge Kappel på tlf. 99 70 66 64.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 17. september 2026.

Samtaler forventes afholdt d 28. september 2026.

Der vil blive søgt en straffeattest inden ansættelsen og denne skal være forenelig med ansættelse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Assistant Professors and/or Associate Professors in Clinical and Preventive Odontology
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark is seeking two motivated individuals for two fixed-term appointments (2 years, up to 37 hours per week, with the possibility of extension). The successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to the establishment of the newly established Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and to play an active role in the development of the upcoming educational programmes for dentists and dental hygienists.

These positions offer a rare opportunity to influence the development of education, research, and clinical teaching from the very beginning, while joining an ambitious academic community dedicated to excellence, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

About the positions

We are seeking candidates with a broad background in dentistry and an interest in the development of university education.

We welcome applicants with diverse dental competencies and subspecialties, for example within:

  • Cariology and Endodontics

  • Periodontology

  • Prosthodontics

  • Orthodontics

  • Oral Surgery

  • Oral Medicine

  • Paediatric Dentistry

  • Clinical Dentistry in General

  • Preventive Dentistry

  • Digital Dentistry

The decisive factor is not your subspecialty alone, but your commitment to contributing to the development of a modern, research-led education in dentistry.

 

Main responsibilities

 

As part of the establishment and development of the department, you will be expected to contribute actively to:

  • the development of the new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, which are expected to commence in the summer of 2027

  • the planning and development of courses and teaching activities

  • teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels

  • teaching dentistry and dental hygiene students

  • the development of clinical learning activities, simulation-based training, and competency-based education

  • student assessment and supervision

  • collaboration with clinical instructors, private training clinics, and other external partners

  • the development of the department’s teaching and learning environment

  • the development and implementation of research projects within clinical and preventive dentistry

  • scientific publishing and dissemination of research findings

  • the development of national and international research collaborations

  • securing external research funding and contributing to grant applications

Teaching will be based on evidence-based dentistry and will emphasize the close integration of basic sciences, clinical skills, and patient care.

Research

The department is concurrently establishing the Research Unit APEX, which aims to build strong national and international research environments within clinical and preventive dentistry.

We are therefore seeking candidates with an interest in research and academic development.

To be successful in this position, we expect you:

  • have documented research experience

  • have published scientific articles in peer-reviewed journals

  • are motivated to further develop your own research profile

  • have an interest in interdisciplinary and international collaboration.

The research component of the position will be tailored to the individual candidate’s qualifications and career stage.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

  • hold a degree in Dentistry

  • have obtained a PhD degree

  • hold Danish authorization to practice as a dentist, or meet the requirements for obtaining Danish authorization

  • combine strong clinical competencies with a well-developed scientific and analytical mindset

  • are motivated to contribute actively to the development of a new dental department

  • thrive in an interdisciplinary university environment

  • possess strong collaborative and interpersonal skills.

In addition, the following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • documented teaching experience

  • experience with curriculum development

  • experience supervising students

  • experience from specialist training or other advanced areas of clinical expertise.

For candidates appointed as Assistant Professors, participation in the Lecturer Training Programme (Universitetspædagogikum) is planned as part of the appointment.

 

Appointment to the positions requires academic qualifications at PhD level and in accordance with the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

 

What we offer

You will become part of a growing department with a unique opportunity to make a significant academic and professional impact.

Among other things, we offer:

  • the opportunity to help shape new educational programmes from the ground up

  • a strong research-based university environment

  • close integration of research, clinical practice, and teaching

  • excellent opportunities for academic career development

  • the opportunity to contribute to the establishment and development of the Research Unit APEX

  • an engaged and ambitious collegial environment with a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and innovation.

About the department

The Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) aims to advance and disseminate new knowledge within dentistry through excellent research, research-based education in SDU’s new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, and close collaboration with the healthcare sector.

The Department will educate the next generation of dentists and dental hygienists through research-based teaching, modern simulation and clinical training, and close engagement with the wider healthcare system, supported by a strong international research environment of the highest academic standard.

Our vision is to create a strong, internationally oriented research and educational environment where clinical excellence, evidence-based practice, and interdisciplinary collaboration go hand in hand.

Application deadline

October 19, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Contact

Further information about the position may be obtained from Professor and Head of Research Torben H. Thygesen, tthygesen@health.sdu.dk, +45 22 34 13 64, or Acting Head of Department and Dean Jakob Grauslund jgrauslund@health.sdu.dk, +45 93 50 70 42.

Salary and terms of employment 

The applicants will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as assistant professor or associate professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. 

In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor or associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application 

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total): 

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 3 for assistant professors, and 6 associate professors, scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy 

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.   

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Assessment 

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process.  

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.  

Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

Join us in shaping the future of dentistry

We are seeking ambitious colleagues who wish to contribute to more than teaching alone. We invite dentists with a passion for academic development, research, and education to join us in building a new academic environment and educating the oral healthcare professionals of the future.

Together, we are creating the foundation for Denmark’s newest Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and shaping the future of dental education and research.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: 1.assistent til rengøringsteam SMP - Fyn
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til vores rengørings-team på Fyn.

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.09.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:

- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.

- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role:

Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments.

This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints.



You will:

 - Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment.

 - Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure.

 - Integrate with the customer's stack: SSO, data warehouses, internal APIs, and SaaS systems.

 - Own Technical Deployments: Serve as the technical owner for complex enterprise implementations, identifying blockers, debugging issues, and driving projects through to successful production adoption.

 - Bridge Customers and Product: Develop a deep understanding of how enterprises use Replit and translate field insights, technical constraints, and recurring customer needs into actionable feedback for Replit’s product and engineering teams.

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences

 - Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data

 - Turn field patterns into templates, playbooks, and product requirements. Ship the best patterns back to the platform.



Required skills and experience:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and deploying production software

 - Strong programming skills and the ability to quickly understand and work across unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and technical environments

 - Hands-on work with LLM applications in production: retrieval, tool calls, and evals.

 - Experience designing and owning complex technical systems from architecture through production

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and independently drive technical projects to completion

 - Strong technical communication skills and experience working directly with customers, partners, or cross-functional stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Finance Systems & Compliance
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead the systems, data, and process work behind how we bill, recognize revenue, close the books, and prove our controls work.



You won't be writing the code or drawing the architecture; you'll be deciding what gets built, in what order, and why it matters. This is a role for someone who wants to understand a business well enough to change how it runs: learning the objectives, processes, and system flows end to end, then shaping them into strategic technical programs with real owners, deliberate sequencing, and decisions that hold up under audit. You'll sit between Finance and Accounting on one side and Engineering, Data, and Product on the other, and you'll be accountable for making new revenue streams operable and auditable, from a pricing model on a slide to a billed invoice, a booked journal entry, and a control that passes testing.



You'll report to the Lead Technical Program Manager for Data, Biztech & AI Transformation, within EPD. You'll get high-level direction and clear priorities from your manager, and independent ownership of how the work actually gets delivered. You'll bring engineering-side rigor and platform thinking to finance problems, and work as part of a team modernizing how the whole company operates.



Most of your time will go to three things: making new product and pricing launches work end to end in the finance stack, running the platforms and data flows behind quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and driving the IT general controls (ITGC) program so controls are designed into systems up front rather than retrofitted after go-live.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Act as Finance's technical counterpart on new product, pricing, and packaging launches, translating commercial models into requirements across order capture, rating and billing, tax, revenue recognition, and downstream reporting, and defining what "revenue-ready" means before go/no-go: who owns each piece, what's actually done versus asserted, and which risks are still cheap to fix

 - Broker the trade-off when a launch date and systems reality don't line up: a scoped manual workaround with an owner, a cost, and an expiration date, plus the path to the automated version. Then close the loop after launch on billing accuracy, exception rates, where revenue landed, whether the new controls actually operate, and what must be true to do this again at 10x volume

 - Independently own delivery and multi-quarter roadmaps for your finance systems programs, including ERP, billing and subscription management, CPQ, revenue subledger, procurement, and the reporting layer on top. Run the working groups that deliver them across Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Data, and Security, with clear accountability and updates leadership can read in two minutes

 - Run the operating rhythm: intake and prioritization, decision logs, early risk escalation, and a small set of metrics that show whether the work is actually improving anything, and flag early when committed scope and capacity don't line up

 - Map current-state processes and data lineage end to end and go after the breaks: reconciliation gaps, recurring manual journal entries, spreadsheets doing load-bearing work, competing sources of truth for the same metric. Partner with Data Engineering on the definitions and data contracts that let finance metrics tie cleanly to source systems, and hold the line when teams drift

 - Drive ITGC workstreams across in-scope financial systems: logical access and segregation of duties, change management, SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, job scheduling, and data interfaces. Partner with Internal Audit on scoping and control design, with a named owner for every control

 - Facilitate designing controls into new systems, systems changes, and launches before go-live with Controllership, Internal Audit, and Engineering, and serve as the systems-side point of contact for internal and external audit on ITGC walkthroughs and testing, translating between control language and engineering language, and driving deficiencies through root cause, named owners, evidence, and validation that the fix holds

 - Build AI-assisted workflows that expand what the teams around you can cover, and hold them to real standards: a defined task, a way to evaluate output quality, explicit human review gates on anything touching financial reporting, and documentation so someone else can run it




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 -  5+ years in technical program management, business systems, finance transformation, or a related field, with substantial time on finance or revenue systems; public-company or IPO-track experience is a strong plus

 - Working fluency in finance operations; you don't need to be an accountant, but you should hold your own on quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and know why revenue recognition is not the same as billing

 - Hands-on ITGC program experience across access, change management, and IT operations for in-scope financial systems, plus practical SOX knowledge. You understand how ITGC reliance determines what auditors will accept from automated controls and system-generated reports, can tell a key control from a non-key one, know where ITACs fit alongside ITGCs, and have been through remediation and audit cycles rather than only reading about them

 - AI-native operating mindset; this is a core requirement for this role. You already use AI to draft requirements, synthesize status, triage intake, and assemble evidence packages, and you share the patterns so others work differently because of what you built

 - A track record of independently delivering technical programs end to end, ideally transformation work such as system modernization, a large-scale migration, or an ERP or billing platform implementation, and turning messy or incomplete inputs into a concrete plan with owners and dates; you're pulled into problems before they're scoped and you're as useful advising a controller on process design as an engineering lead on sequencing

 - Working understanding of data lifecycle and analytics tooling, and real experience running change management for business systems, not just launching them

 - Influence without authority and a bias toward closure. You have no direct reports, so you work through credibility and clear reasoning, knowing when to push and when to escalate; you chase ambiguous items to a decision, will reopen the uncomfortable question a week before launch, and communicate clearly with Director/VP+ stakeholders, including when the news is bad




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Hands-on experience working in enterprise billing, ERP, and revenue systems such as NetSuite, Stripe, or comparable tools, with an understanding of how orders, invoices, and revenue data flow between them

 - Experience supporting an IPO readiness or first-year SOX program, including standing up ITGCs from scratch

 - CISA, CIA, or equivalent certification, or equivalent time embedded on an IT audit team

 - Experience building internal tooling or agents on a workspace platform rather than only configuring vendor systems

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Own how our Foundations business teams design, automate, and operate their most important workflows.



Notion is growing quickly, and the processes that run our business — intake, triage, execution, approvals, escalations, reporting — need to scale without adding headcount or losing auditability. This role exists to redesign those processes end to end and to embed AI directly into them, so the work moves faster and the system stays trustworthy.



What's different at Notion: you'll build on Notion as customer zero. You'll design multi-system workflows spanning Notion, Slack, email, support tooling, and internal data, then ship the custom agents, skills, and automations that run them — partnering with Finance, Legal, People, Ops, Data, and Engineering to drive real adoption, not just documentation.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Redesign cross-functional processes end to end: Map and optimize core and cross-functional flows for Foundations business teams, making them simpler, faster, and more consistent than the operating models they replace.

 - Architect multi-system workflows: Design workflows spanning Notion, Slack, email, support tooling, and internal systems and data, with clear states, routing, permissions, and auditability.

 - Design for failure, not just the happy path: Identify edge cases, controls, and handoffs so workflows are resilient, reviewable, and easy for a business team to operate without you.

 - Embed AI with clear human-in-the-loop patterns: Define where AI assists, automates, approves, and audits — and make it obvious what AI did and why.

 - Build and maintain custom agents and skills: Ship the agents, structured skills, and runbooks that power intake triage, summarization, routing, escalation, and reporting for business teams.

 - Instrument everything you ship: Define success metrics (cycle time, deflection, quality, adoption), measure them, and iterate based on data and stakeholder feedback.

 - Set the standards others build on: Establish best practices for AI safety, permissions, transparency, and workflow documentation so the patterns hold as more teams adopt them.

 - Drive adoption and change management: Partner with business stakeholders so tooling gets used because it's intuitive and reliable, and measurably improves day-to-day work.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 -  Process and systems design depth: 2–6 years in operations design, service design, product operations, business systems, or internal tools, with a portfolio showing systems thinking and measurable outcomes.

 - Complex workflow experience: Demonstrated ability to design for intake, triage, routing, approvals, escalations, and reporting across teams and tools, including states, permissions, and auditability.

 - Process mapping rigor: Hands-on experience mapping and improving business processes through journey maps, service blueprints, operating models, and SOPs.

 - AI-native builder mindset: Experience designing or building with AI assistants and agents, workflow automation, or internal tooling — including prompt design, tool selection, and evaluation for quality, reliability, and edge cases. This role requires AI fluency.

 - Lightweight automation ability: Comfort building with Notion custom agents and automations, structured skills, and integrations across systems (APIs, webhooks, connectors). Hands-on preferred.

 - Clear communication and stakeholder judgment: Ability to convey design intent using whatever artifact fits the problem, and to present and defend tradeoffs across multiple tools and teams.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: Experience operating in fast-moving environments and collaborating deeply with engineers and PMs to shape decisions, not just execute them.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Consulting background in technology, process and operations consulting, or business/digital transformation — including discovery, current- and future-state process mapping, and stakeholder workshops

 - Track record delivering client engagements across multiple functions or industries, and turning that pattern recognition into repeatable playbooks and operating standards

 - Experience designing internal tools, developer platforms, or enterprise software

 - Familiarity with data concepts (schemas, event tracking, dashboards) and operational analytics

 - Notion product expertise

jobs.title: Director of Compensation Strategy
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ROLE SUMMARY

Replit is the world's most widely used AI coding platform, and as we scale, we're rebuilding how compensation works internally from the ground up. This role owns that. You'll go beyond traditional comp management to architect the systems, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled workflows that make fast, consistent, and high-quality compensation decisions possible at scale. 

You will serve as the architect of our compensation engine: translating compensation philosophy into scalable systems, and utilizing AI to improve speed, accuracy, and transparency. 

You will partner closely with People Business Partners, Recruiting, Finance, People Operations, and the Data team to embed compensation directly into company workflows, eliminating manual processes and reducing reliance on comp as a service layer.

You will shape how we attract, reward, and retain top talent, while building infrastructure that scales with the business.
